text:
Marie Chen: Heads up — Nvidia flagged a reduction in H100 slot allocations for next month, looks like ~25% below our forecast. Need a contingency plan.
Omar Reyes: ugh. Which regions are hit and which SKUs? :grimacing:
Marie Chen: US-west + eu-central. Affected SKUs: H100-80GB and the baseline H200 slices for some Dedicated pools. Vendor says shipments reallocated to hyperscalers.
Jing Li: Can we route affected requests to MI300 or Gaudi variants? Latency hit is ~15–30ms on our tests but throughput is OK. Fallback routing with canary seems reasonable.
Sree Nair: +1. Also we should prepare marketplace SKU mapping and short pricing/backfill notes so customers see expected perf/cost deltas.
Rohan Patel: Draft routing policy for review — sketched this morning, needs validation from infra and runtime: 
```
route_policy:
  - match: model.family == "h100-family"
    fallback: ["mi300-variant", "gaudi-1x"]
    prefer_region: [us-west, eu-central]
    degrade_strategy: "pref-batch"
    canary_pct: 5
```
Marie Chen: Good start. Ask vendor for ETA and if any driver/firmware differences will break our pinned images. Also want to know if replacement units are expected in <30 days.
Omar Reyes: Can eng-infra spin up extra MI300 capacity quickly if we go that route? @eng-infra please chime in.
DevOps Bot: infra alert — MI300 pool currently shows ~18% spare capacity in us-west, ~5% in eu-central. Thermal headroom limited in us-west racks.
Jing Li: That thermal note matters — if MI300 fills, batch sizing might need to change. Rerun perf regression on the canary at small scale tomorrow.
Sree Nair: Action items: 1) Marie to draft vendor note and request replenishment ETA, 2) Rohan to finalize routing YAML and commit canary tests, 3) eng-infra to confirm scheduling, thermal impact, and extra capacity timeline, 4) Partner-eng (Sree) to prepare marketplace copy and price diff table. Target: EOD Thursday.
Rohan Patel: I'll add automated test harness steps and a perf table to the PR. Also adding fallback metrics (latency p50/p95, cost delta).
Marie Chen: We should also delay any co-announced press until capacity is stable. I'll ask Legal for embargo wording. No one wants a joint marketing blunder.
Omar Reyes: Agreed. Quick comms template for partners: "temporary capacity-aware routing to alternate accelerators; negligible customer impact; monitoring active". Keep language calm.
DevOps Bot: Ticket created INC-2026-457: "Vendor H100 allocation reduction — capacity routing plan".
Marie Chen: Thanks all — I'll send the vendor note now and post updates here. If eng-infra confirms MI300 can scale in 72h, we can flip a canary and monitor. :white_check_mark:
